pages.title: The Pursuit meter
pages.text: “The $(l:beyond/heralds)Heralds$(/l) do not come by chance. Every return brings the next trial closer.”$(br2)Each trip into the Beyond increases Pursuit by a growing amount: +1, then +2, +3, and so on. When the meter reaches 100, a Herald appears the next time you return to the Overworld.

pages.title: When does a Herald appear?
pages.text: After 13 trips, the total is 91. The fourteenth adds 14, bringing the meter to 105. A $(l:beyond/heralds)Herald$(/l) appears, and after subtracting 100, 5 Pursuit points remain.$(br2)The number of trips needed for later Heralds is therefore not fixed: the remainder carries into the next cycle.

pages.title: Herald Hearts
pages.text: You can reduce Pursuit using the $(l:beyond/storm_heart)Heart of Storm$(/l), $(l:beyond/hunger_heart)Heart of Hunger$(/l), or $(l:beyond/cold_heart)Heart of Cold$(/l). Hold a heart and right-click the Beyond Echo block to reduce the meter by 100.$(br2)The meter can become negative. This does not cancel the cycle; you will need to build Pursuit back up before the next $(l:beyond/heralds)Herald$(/l) appears.
